title: Apply a discount
prompt: Write a function named apply_discount that takes a price and an optional percent. When percent is left out it should default to 10. The function returns the price after taking that percentage off it, so a price of 200 with the default percent returns 180.0. Return the new price, do not print it.

title: Greeting with defaults
prompt: Write a function named build_greeting that takes a name and two optional parameters, greeting which defaults to "Hello" and punctuation which defaults to "!". It returns one string made of the greeting, then a comma and a space, then the name, then the punctuation. So build_greeting("Ada") returns "Hello, Ada!". Return the string, do not print it.

title: Count the long words
prompt: Write a function named count_long_words that takes a list of words and an optional min_length that defaults to 4. It returns how many words in the list are strictly longer than min_length, so a word whose length equals min_length does not count. An empty list gives 0. Return the count, do not print it.

title: Initials
prompt: Write a function named initials that takes two strings, first and last, each holding at least one character, and returns the two initials in upper case with a full stop after each one. So initials("ada", "lovelace") returns "A.L.". Return the string, do not print it.

title: Average that survives an empty list
prompt: Write a function named safe_average that takes a list of numbers and returns their average. If the list is empty it returns 0 instead of failing. Return the number, do not print it.
